references.text: Another representative from the tribe of Benjamin is mentioned in connection with the census, highlighting the tribe's role in Israel's organization.
Palti son of Raphu represented the tribe of Benjamin among the spies sent to Canaan, a similar leadership role for the tribe.
Benjamin was Jacob's youngest son, and this verse tells of his birth and naming, which is the origin of the tribe of Benjamin.
The sons of Benjamin are listed when Jacob and his family went down to Egypt, showing the tribe's lineage.
The tribal inheritance of Benjamin in Canaan is described in detail, and Elidad was appointed to help with the distribution of this territory.
